```lean
theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] {X : C} (R : CategoryTheory.ProjectiveResolution X) : R.cochainComplex.IsKProjective := by
  have h_strictly_le : R.cochainComplex.IsStrictlyLE 0 := CategoryTheory.ProjectiveResolution.instIsStrictlyLECochainComplexOfNatInt R
  have h_projective : ∀ (n : ℤ), CategoryTheory.Projective (R.cochainComplex.X n) :=
    CategoryTheory.ProjectiveResolution.instProjectiveXIntCochainComplex R
  exact CochainComplex.isKProjective_of_projective R.cochainComplex h_strictly_le h_projective
```
